_comment: Model manifest for SvaraFlow's speech-to-text tiers. The 'url' fields are marked TODO: fill them in once these models are hosted somewhere public. The downloader treats a value of 'TODO' as 'skip download and use the file already at %LOCALAPPDATA%/SvaraFlow/models/<filename>'. Do not commit model files; they are gitignored.

models.name: Whisper-Hindi2Hinglish-Swift
models.description: Whisper-base-sized Hindi-to-Hinglish model. Fast, lower accuracy. Writes Roman Hinglish directly.

models.name: Whisper-Hindi2Hinglish-Apex
models.description: Large-v3-turbo-based Hindi-to-Hinglish model. Slower, higher accuracy. Writes Roman Hinglish directly.
